title: Shitty Models
author: Thorsten Sommer
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.ba4gigtw

steps.title: Establish Context
steps.instruction: Frame the activity by defining the purpose of working with Shitty Models, the intentions behind the exercise, the learning objectives, and how the method integrates into the course.

steps.title: Conduct Kick-off
steps.instruction: Introduce the group to the background of the project and the concept of failure.

substeps.instruction: Provide background information, such as Shitty Robots.
Give a short talk on the 'Culture of Failure' and how failure facilitates progress.

steps.title: Prepare Materials
steps.instruction: Familiarize the group with available materials and establish group work rules that encourage creativity, experimentation, and exploration.

steps.title: Build Shitty Model
steps.instruction: Allow participants to build or program their Shitty Model, allocating a large portion of the available time to this step.

steps.title: Present Results
steps.instruction: Have groups or individuals present their achievements, which may include the final model and the portfolio of different variants created.

substeps.instruction: Choose between an entertaining show or a conventional presentation format.

steps.title: Reflect and Provide Feedback
steps.instruction: Reflect on learning objectives to make participants aware of their learning process and exchange best practices and lessons learned.

substeps.instruction: Ensure no direct correction or assessment is given, as there are no right or wrong characteristics for these models.
